snippet.title: Terrinoth Heroes of Descent | AG French Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent presents its turn-based tactical gameplay in a new gameplay overview. This RPG set in the universe of the Descent board game will be playable solo or in co-op across around twenty different missions. The game will be available this summer on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series. (↓)
